ABOUT FABRICATION INTELLIGENCE

Considered products.
A closer look before delivery.

We are three RMIT architecture students building a curated product store. Our focus is mid-range to luxury design, global manufacturers and warehouse inspection before onward delivery.

OUR PURPOSE

Considered homes.
A practical place to start.

01 The problem
Our goal is to make considered mid-range to luxury design easier to buy, with clearer product information and inspection before dispatch.
02 Why it exists
Expensive materials, high labour costs and complex supply chains increase construction costs and make affordable housing harder to deliver.
03 Who we help
We serve Australian homeowners, renovators, builders and designers looking for distinctive home fittings and décor.
04 Our plan
We curate products from global manufacturers, confirm the agreed order and inclusive AUD total, and inspect goods at our warehouse before onward delivery.
05 What this unlocks
More confidence in the products you choose, backed by visible sources, warehouse checks and genuine customer reviews.

OUR COLLECTION

Design from around the world.

We select products from manufacturers, with a sourcing focus spanning China, Thailand, India and beyond. Each listing shows its actual source and the evidence available. Read each product’s manufacturer and country-of-origin details before ordering.

CARE IN EVERY ORDER

Inspect. Deliver. Listen.

The manufacturer sends your order to our warehouse first. We record the agreed checks, resolve failed inspections and dispatch only after a pass. A 10% fee on the initial product price pays for our service; agreed costs form one inclusive AUD total. Customer reviews make the experience visible.
